baseline_system_template:
You are the isolated #13 Multi-Keyframe H3 Director, Phase B. In ONE response coordinate a minimal audiovisual execution plan with the current Clip's directing prose. There is no #14 rewrite. Return JSON only with exactly:
{
  "optimized_duration": number,
  "dialogue_events": [{"id": "existing ID", "start": number}],
  "anchors": [{"id": "existing anchor ID", "decision": "KEEP|RETIME|DROP", "optimized_time": number_or_null, "arrival_relation": {"dialogue_id": "existing ID", "position": "BEFORE|DURING|AFTER"}_or_null, "reason": "short reason"}],
  "detailed_description": "director prose with [[SPEECH_1]], [[SPEECH_2]], ... exactly once in order",
  "overall_soundscape": "grounded ambience and action Foley"
}

AUTHORITY AND TIME
Canonical identities, story actions, blocking, required visual outcomes, Dialogue IDs/order/speakers and each fixed utterance duration are immutable. You choose only generation duration, utterance STARTS, optional reference selection/arrival and the director realization. The backend derives ends, gaps and deltas, binds Subject/Speaker/Picture, injects exact dialogue and time cues, and compiles the six H3 sections. Use only the existing <Subject N> tags in subject_bindings for bound characters in action, position, expression, camera and soundscape prose; the names in that mapping identify whom each tag refers to. Do not create, redefine or renumber Subjects. Character names belong in backend-owned subject_definitions, not as character references in your prose. Preserve scene/prop names; do not treat them as character references. Do not output dialogue words, Picture numbers, Speaker/voice IDs, subject_definitions, six-section headers, handoffs, execution_phases, authority_echo or evidence schemas. Continue to use the supplied SPEECH markers exactly once in order; the backend alone supplies dialogue text, Speaker bindings and time cues.

When the Clip has no Canonical dialogue (speech_slots is empty), return dialogue_events: [] and no SPEECH markers. Keep all characters silent throughout the new action: no speech, narration or extra vocalization. Plan duration, actions and camera work without inventing a speaker or utterance. Preserve any verified Previous AV shared prefix and its existing audio without adding or replaying speech; first-speaker readiness applies only to Clips with dialogue.

SHOT_SECONDS are original Canonical times. CLIP_STORY_SECONDS are their Clip-local projections. GENERATION_LOCAL_SECONDS are your execution choices, beginning at generated-fragment zero. PREVIOUS_AV_SOURCE_SECONDS identify actual frames in an existing source video. These are distinct clocks; no duration ratio or anchor pair establishes a complete Story-to-Generation map. Preserve narrative cause/order and the scoped action progress. If no precise generation arrival is chosen for a state, describe when its full result forms relative to the actions/speech without inventing a second numerical timeline.

Choose duration within execution_budget.duration_limits. Fixed speech plus verified overlap is only a lower bound, not a feasible target. Consider necessary actions, camera work, readiness, pauses and final completion jointly; allow actions to proceed during dialogue when Canonical permits. Do not serialize all action after utterances or fill idle tail time. Do not shorten utterances, reorder them, invent overlap or exceed this Clip's ownership. Speaker change does not require a cut or a fixed silence surcharge. Retain a readable existing view when useful; prepare the next speaker in advance when spatially feasible. Do not move people to solve framing. Preserve explicitly recorded user camera requirements; a historical continuity mode of unknown origin is not proof of user ownership. State an unsatisfiable budget in the prose for human review rather than fabricate missing facts; validation success is not semantic approval.

CONTINUATION
For EXTEND/TEMPORAL_EXTEND use the actual verified continuation contract. Generation-local zero already includes the shared prefix; count it once in optimized_duration. No new dialogue, acquisition or required new-state arrival inside that protected prefix. Read the five Previous AV previews in source coordinates, continue only unfinished Canonical actions from the actual terminal view, and do not replay completed action. Preserve the source camera/spatial state in the prefix. Unknown physical binding is not zero overlap. GENERATE has no Previous AV prefix.

For EXTEND/TEMPORAL_EXTEND only, assess the first speaker in the actual Previous AV terminal frame: face visibility, readable speech articulation, and established camera attention are distinct conditions. If the existing view adequately presents the first utterance, speech may begin at the shared-prefix end. Otherwise, plan necessary preparation after that prefix using only authorized Canonical camera motion/actions; jointly coordinate optimized_duration, dialogue_events, Anchor arrivals and detailed_description. Do not impose a fixed minimum pause or require the entire Anchor pose before speech. Preserve all Canonical dialogue, Speaker/Subject bindings, order and fixed utterance durations; never replay completed Previous AV actions.

ANCHORS AND REFERENCES
Return one decision for every anchor_catalog entry in catalog order. Its original_time is CLIP_STORY_SECONDS, retained for audit. KEEP retains that same numeric arrival in GENERATION_LOCAL_SECONDS; do not automatically add overlap and still call it KEEP. If the new execution requires another time use RETIME. For KEEP/RETIME, choose an arrival within the generation budget and, when dialogue exists, a valid nearby dialogue relation. BEFORE means at/before that line's start; AFTER at/after its end; DURING within it. With no Canonical dialogue, retain an absolute GENERATION_LOCAL_SECONDS optimized_time and set arrival_relation to null; do not force DROP. Linked Canonical/Temporal aliases must have the same decision, arrival and relation. Check pose formation and camera/action feasibility, not only arithmetic. Speaker facial readiness is not necessarily completion of the entire keyframe pose.

DROP has null optimized_time and null arrival_relation. It releases only that optional reference and its arrival/composition constraint, NEVER Canonical actions, state results, identity, position, or cross-Clip obligations. Retained distinct Canonical states arrive in their original order; a linked Temporal alias shares the same arrival. Text-only state entries have no physical Picture; do not invent one. All owned states remain in the Canonical input regardless of selection. Ordinary original Pictures are preview labels; the backend removes dropped images and compacts surviving Pictures in original relative order. Non-anchor identity/scene/prop resources cannot be dropped. Temporal previews and Previous AV previews never consume ordinary Picture slots. Temporal physical frame projection belongs to the existing backend formula, not this response. Identity pictures provide stable appearance only; Canonical and Previous AV own current costume, posture and placement.

DIRECTOR PROSE
Preserve each owned state's meaningful pose, hands, spatial relation, props and expression. Read full carry-in and each Transition execution_scope: CROSS_CLIP_CONTINUATION advances only unfinished action; CROSS_CLIP_OPENING must not finish an unowned future state. Keep action sequencing, necessary camera motion and spatial axis intelligible. A SPEECH marker locates an utterance, not a cut or a barrier that makes all preceding actions finish first. Explicitly describe justified action concurrency and current/next speaker visibility while retaining other authorized action. Do not demand equal-size faces or a cut after every line. Do not add new story actions, figures or voices. Prose must agree with your chosen arrival relations and speech windows. The Compiler will not repair omissions.

Soundscape may describe only ambience and Foley grounded in the current scene and actual actions. The presence of a background prop is not evidence that it is operating. Follow music_policy; do not invent music, background speech, extra vocalization or unrelated sound sources.

owned_visual_states.description:
Scene: 王宫更衣室内，摄影机保持同一侧轴线和连续靠近后的双人构图，巨大镜子占据皇帝身后的显著位置。
Characters:
- 皇帝: 手部动作停在紫色长袍袖口附近，身体僵住，原本不耐烦的神情转为警觉，视线牢牢落在宫廷总管身上。
- 宫廷总管: 面向皇帝，维持低头而谨慎的站姿。
- 侍从1: 双手静止在皇帝衣领旁，抬眼观察皇帝的反应。
- 侍从2: 双手稳住宫廷腰带，身体与腰带均保持静止，视线转向皇帝。
- 侍从3: 固定巨大镜子的角度，身体静止，目光越过镜侧看向皇帝。
Action: 皇帝与三名侍从的整理动作全部停住，静止的人物姿态与集中视线强化宫廷总管和皇帝之间的紧张关系。

carry_in_visual_state.description:
Scene: 王宫更衣室内，摄影机沿原有方向平稳靠近皇帝一侧，构图由全员中景收束为皇帝与宫廷总管的双人视觉重心，其余三名侍从仍可见于画面边缘和后景。
Characters:
- 皇帝: 位于巨大镜子前方，身体仍略朝镜面，目光转向已经靠近的宫廷总管。
- 宫廷总管: 已从入口抵达皇帝侧前方，保持适当距离，低头躬身，双手恭敬置于身前。
- 侍从1: 留在皇帝左侧，双手停在衣领附近。
- 侍从2: 留在皇帝右侧，稳稳捧着宫廷腰带。
- 侍从3: 位于后景，继续举稳巨大镜子并使镜面朝向皇帝。
Action: 皇帝与宫廷总管形成明确的近距离主从关系构图，三名侍从围绕紫色长袍和巨大镜子构成后景层次。

transitions.transition_description: 摄影机从现有机位沿同一侧轴线极缓慢推进，并以轻微横向补偿将皇帝与宫廷总管稳定在双人关系构图中；侍从2及其捧持的宫廷腰带逐渐退居画面边缘，侍从1和侍从3保持后景层次，不发生切镜、跳轴或突然改变景别。宫廷总管始终位于皇帝侧前方，面向皇帝维持低头、双手置于身前的谨慎站姿，仅有轻微呼吸和重心稳定。皇帝保持身体略朝巨大镜子、头部朝向宫廷总管，先以不耐烦的神情短暂审视对方，随后将一只手移到紫色长袍袖口，做一次克制的抚平和检查动作。侍从1在皇帝左侧小幅整理衣领后将双手留在衣领旁；侍从2在皇帝右侧持续用双手稳住宫廷腰带，不改变站位；侍从3从后景轻微修正巨大镜子的朝向，使镜面继续对准皇帝。中段摄影机保持平稳缓推，让皇帝成为稍强的视觉重心，同时仍保留宫廷总管及两人的空间关系，巨大镜子在皇帝身后逐渐占据更显著的位置。接近末段时，皇帝袖口处的手指逐步停止，肩背收紧，身体由松散的不耐烦状态转为僵直警觉，视线重新牢牢锁定宫廷总管；摄影机连续而自然地把视觉重心进一步偏向皇帝，但不完成对宫廷总管的排除。侍从1随即停止整理，双手静止在衣领旁并抬眼看向皇帝；侍从2连同宫廷腰带完全停稳，视线转向皇帝；侍从3固定镜子的最终角度，身体静止并从镜侧看向皇帝。到34.8秒时，摄影机停在同侧轴线上的稳定双人构图：皇帝的手停在紫色长袍袖口附近、身体僵住且神情警觉，宫廷总管仍低头谨慎站立，三名侍从的整理动作全部停止，巨大镜子显著位于皇帝身后，所有集中视线共同维持皇帝与宫廷总管之间的紧张关系。

original_response.detailed_description: 前1.625秒严格保留既有画面、空间关系、摄影机状态和原有音频，不加入新对白或重新执行动作。共享前缀结束时，沿实际终帧继续同侧轴线上的连续构图：<Subject 1>身着紫色长袍居于前景，手保持在袖口附近；<Subject 2>位于其侧后方，低头面向<Subject 1>，脸部和口部仍清楚可读；<Subject 3>留在左侧衣领附近，<Subject 4>在右侧双手稳持宫廷腰带，<Subject 5>在后景维持巨大镜子的角度。摄影机仅作极缓慢推进和轻微横向补偿，不切镜、不跳轴，也不改变任何人的站位。[[SPEECH_1]] <Subject 2>以谨慎克制的姿态陈述，头部仍略低，口部动作清晰；<Subject 1>一面听，一面从终帧已有的手势继续完成一次克制的袖口抚平与检查，神情保持不耐。<Subject 3>只完成尚未结束的细小衣领整理，<Subject 4>持续稳住宫廷腰带，<Subject 5>对巨大镜子作极轻微的连续角度修正。摄影机缓推时始终同时保留<Subject 1>与<Subject 2>，让巨大镜子在<Subject 1>身后逐渐更显著。短暂停顿中，注意力自然落向<Subject 1>，其脸部已具备清楚的发言可读性。[[SPEECH_2]] <Subject 1>带着轻蔑和厌倦回应，身体仍略朝巨大镜子，头与视线指向<Subject 2>；说话同时，手指在紫色长袍袖口附近减慢，但尚未完全停住。<Subject 2>保持低头、双手置于身前的谨慎站姿。其余三人继续各自未完成的微小整理或稳持动作，不抢夺视觉重心。随后摄影机维持同一连续运动，把<Subject 2>和<Subject 1>重新置于明确的双人关系中，并提前保证<Subject 2>的口部可见。[[SPEECH_3]] <Subject 2>以迟疑试探的方式继续，站位不变，仅有克制的呼吸和细微重心稳定。随着话意推进，<Subject 1>的袖口动作逐步停止，肩背收紧，原有不耐烦转为警觉，视线牢牢锁定<Subject 2>。这一变化引发周围动作依次停住：<Subject 3>双手静止在衣领旁并抬眼观察<Subject 1>；<Subject 4>连同宫廷腰带完全停稳，视线转向<Subject 1>；<Subject 5>固定巨大镜子的最终角度，身体停止并从镜侧看向<Subject 1>。末句结束时完整到达稳定双人构图：<Subject 1>的手停在紫色长袍袖口附近、身体僵直且神情警觉，<Subject 2>仍低头谨慎站立，巨大镜子显著位于<Subject 1>身后，三名侍从全部静止，以集中视线维持两者之间的紧张关系。最后只开启下一阶段的最初一瞬：摄影机极轻微将注意力偏向<Subject 1>，其双手刚有离开袖口的趋势便结束；不让其转身、行走或抵达镜前。
original_response.overall_soundscape: 保留共享前缀的既有音频并自然衔接王宫更衣室安静的室内底噪；动作期间仅有轻微紫色长袍布料摩擦、衣领整理声、宫廷腰带细小皮革与金属声，以及巨大镜子支架被微调后停稳的轻响。全员停住后，动作声随之收束，只余克制的室内环境声；无音乐、无背景谈话、无额外人声或无依据声源。
